FindTool.purpose: Registers api.find and supplies its limits to the shared header lookup.

ReadTool.purpose: Registers api.read and delegates a bounded read to the shared header lookup.

SkeletonPreviewTool.purpose: Returns source and CMake strings for an Express application or router module.

HouseStyleResource.purpose: Serves the shared SNode.C instruction text at the house-style URI.

ReviewPrompt.purpose: Builds a code-review prompt from the house style and the supplied code. Registered, with no native prompt call observed in Codex.

StyleTemplate.purpose: Resolves the style section variable and serves the overview.

ReviewLabelResource.purpose: Owns the selected label and updates the resource when the value changes.

ReviewLabelTool.purpose: Requests a non-sensitive label, then updates the paired resource after acceptance.

ProtocolErrorTool.purpose: Completes the call with a deliberate JSON-RPC InvalidParams error.

StructuredTool.purpose: Provides the valid and invalid variants of the structured-answer example.

SchemaTool.purpose: Defines the referenced input schema and echoes the accepted arguments.

HeadersTool.purpose: Declares the region argument and its HTTP header mirror.

ContentTool.purpose: Produces text, image, audio, a resource link and embedded text and binary content.

PrincipalTool.purpose: Reports the application-authorized identity obtained from the request context.

WorkTool.purpose: Registers ordinary, optional-task and required-task work. It delegates execution to the work helper.

InputTool.purpose: Implements the five registered input modes through the same class.

InputResource.purpose: Requests a form while reading showcase://input and returns the resulting action.

InputPrompt.purpose: Requests a form during prompt retrieval. Registered, with no native prompt call observed in Codex.

LoggingTool.purpose: Reports whether logging was admitted for the request.

SamplingTool.purpose: Requests client sampling with selected media, options and tool-loop behavior.

ClientTaskTool.purpose: Exercises client-owned task creation and lifecycle controls when supported.

RootsTool.purpose: Requests the filesystem roots that the client chooses to disclose.

TextResourceItem.purpose: Serves showcase://text as text with metadata and cache hints.

BlobResourceItem.purpose: Serves showcase://blob as generated binary content.

CounterResource.purpose: Owns the counter used by resource reads and the update demo.

UpdateTool.purpose: Increments the counter and returns its revision.

GreetingTemplate.purpose: Expands a name into a greeting.

PathTemplate.purpose: Reads a URI template with a reserved path expansion.

ConversationPrompt.purpose: Builds a two-message prompt that embeds showcase text. Registered, with no native prompt call observed in Codex.

CatalogueTool.purpose: Returns the name for each catalogue tool, including the dynamically registered instance.

CatalogueResource.purpose: Serves the named fixed catalogue resources and the dynamic resource.

CataloguePrompt.purpose: Supplies the catalogue and dynamic prompt entries. Dynamic registration was exercised, while prompt retrieval was unavailable.

CatalogueTemplate.purpose: Returns the captured variable for the fixed catalogue and dynamic resource templates.

DynamicTool.purpose: Adds and removes four registrations together using the server registry.

registry-list.title: Resource inventory
registry-list.purpose: The server lists descriptions from registered entries. It does not call the individual resource read methods for discovery.

template-list.title: Resource template inventory
template-list.purpose: The server lists registered resource template descriptions.

registry-read.title: Resource dispatch
registry-read.purpose: The server resolves the URI against a fixed registration or template and dispatches to the selected class.

tool-dispatch.title: Tool dispatch and input validation
tool-dispatch.purpose: The server validates arguments against the registered schema before calling the tool class.

output-validation.title: Tool output validation
output-validation.purpose: A tool response with a registered output schema is checked before it is returned to the client.

task-augmentation.title: Task augmentation validation
task-augmentation.purpose: The server checks the requested task metadata against the tool’s task support and the protocol path.

captureModes.native-tool-result: Native tool return recorded in full.
captureModes.native-json-text: Exact JSON string returned by the resource helper.
captureModes.native-exception: Exact error text surfaced by the Codex helper.
captureModes.recorded-tool-projection: Recorded selection of tool-result fields with long values clipped in the baseline capture.
captureModes.recorded-resource-projection: Recorded contents, summary or clipped resource text from the original read.
captureModes.decoded-native-resource-result: Native resource helper response parsed as JSON.
captureModes.local-server-list-projection: Native discovery entries scoped to the four local SNode.C connections.
captureModes.dynamic-inventory-projection: Relevant dynamic entries from a native discovery response and the observed tool exposure.
